question: Which of the following is a straight chain alkane composed of 4 carbon atoms that is commonly used as a fuel and aerosol propellant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Butane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Butane** is a straight-chain alkane composed of **4 carbon atoms** (C4H10).
 
• It is commonly used as a **fuel in lighters** and as an aerosol propellant in various industries.
 
• Butane is a highly flammable hydrocarbon gas and is part of the liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) used for cooking and heating.
 
• It exists in two structural isomers: n-butane (straight chain) and isobutane (branched chain), but the question refers specifically to the straight-chain form.
 
• Due to its energy density and portability, butane is widely used in both industrial and household applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alkanes:**

 
 
• Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons containing only single bonds between carbon atoms.
 
• They follow the general formula **CnH2n+2**, where "n" represents the number of carbon atoms.
 
• Examples of alkanes include methane (CH4), ethane (C2H6), and propane (C3H8).
 
 
 
• **Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG):**
 
 
• LPG is a mixture of hydrocarbons, primarily propane and butane.
 
• It is used as a fuel for cooking, heating, and in vehicles.
 
• LPG is stored under pressure in liquid form and vaporizes when released.
 
 
 
• **Aerosol Propellants:**
 
 
• Butane is widely used as a propellant in aerosol sprays due to its flammability and ability to vaporize quickly.
 
• It is used in products like deodorants, air fresheners, and spray paints.
 
 
 
• **Isomers of Butane:**
 
 
• Butane has two isomers: n-butane (straight chain) and isobutane (branched chain).
 
• Isobutane is used in the petrochemical industry to produce high-octane gasoline components.
